One bet at most per game; settle sequentially. This is not the EPL joint same-date funding rule.

Eighth-Kelly stake = current cash × (1/8) × max(0, (probability × odds − 1) / (odds − 1)).
Do not add an EPL-style 2% cap to these source rules. A positive estimated return is a model claim, not a guaranteed gain.
